reviews.text: Thanks Martin!!
They couldn't be more charming, and they take such good care of the dogs; they all looked so happy! Mine came out of the groomer looking like Victoria Beckham in 2000!
Thanks Lola!!
With care and professionalism, they left my dog ​​smelling like flowers and looking handsome, very handsome.
Thanks Javier!
Excellent professionals
The best daycare also has the best dog grooming salon in Madrid :)

When I take my dog ​​there, I feel so good because he's doing so well. He has a wonderful time, pampered by the very professional staff and with his four-legged friends. So much love, attention, affection, and care. I 100% recommend it for daily dog ​​boarding because he'll have a great time! ❤️

I've been taking my dog since she was a puppy over a year ago and I trust them implicitly. They are warm, kind, incredibly caring. Any issues she has they are there to help and advise. She loves going.
Magnificent. Very happy.

Dante has been going to the COVIS daycare for a week now to socialize, and I couldn't be happier.

The staff are all lovely, always smiling.

But it's not just me who has to like it, and every time we go into Marcenado, Dante just pulls and pulls until we get to the entrance. There's no better sign than that that they love dogs there.
The little ones are happy and always want to come in and spend the day. The staff pamper them and attend to them with devotion.

We have been going to Covis Guarderia for a few months now and I am very happy with the place and service. Ladies who are taking care of dogs are very nice and competent, they make sure that every dog is happy and safe. My girl is going there every day gladly and spends a fantastic time socializing and playing with other dogs. Definitely recommend the place! 🙂
Super professional. They dedicate as much time as the dog needs and the result is spectacular. I will definitely use them again.
Thank you, Isabel!
Very happy with the daycare and grooming services. They take great care of the dogs and love them very much. A very good place.
Fantastic service, excellent professionals
The service has been wonderful from the very beginning, and it's clear they are true professionals who care for the dogs with great affection. We will definitely be back. Highly recommended!
Thanks Marco!
It was a wonderful experience entrusting Wolf's care to the COVIS team and facility during this time; both were superb. Thank you very much.

We took our dog Lana to Covis's grooming salon and she looked absolutely stunning. She looked gorgeous; everyone was staring at her on the street. She left feeling very relaxed, and you can really see the professionalism and care they give to the dogs. Thank you so much, we'll be back very soon!
They treat puppies, and they bathe and groom them well.
I took my dog ​​to the groomer and I left delighted.
Impeccable service, finally a daycare that cares for them as if they were their own!
Ramona and Tiger asking me to go to Covis!! Totally recommended!

I left my dog ​​Chapo at this kennel and I was absolutely delighted. From the very first moment, they instilled so much confidence in me! It's clear that Covi and her team know what they're doing and treat the dogs as if they were their own. They sent me photos and videos so I could see how he was doing, and he looked happy, playing, and resting peacefully. When I went to pick him up, he almost didn't want to leave! 😅 A fantastic place, with very caring and professional staff. Without a doubt, the best option for leaving your dog when you can't be with him.
Complete confidence and peace of mind!!! I've been a customer since day one and I'm happier every day.

The best daycare in Madrid!
Unbeatable service and attention!
Not good service. I bathed my puppy here but his fur was not cleaned properly.

I took my dog ​​for a bath and haircut, and they did a fantastic job. Without a doubt, the best place I've ever been. The staff were also incredibly friendly, and my dog ​​left happier than when he arrived.
I took my dog ​​for her bath and grooming, and they made her look absolutely gorgeous. The staff is very attentive and professional, and they treat pets with so much love. ❤️🤗 …

My rating for Covis doesn't do it justice; 5 stars is far too little for such a top-notch establishment. It's the best place you can take your pets. They understand dogs and care for them like no one else, with absolute love and dedication, and the support of the best veterinarians, Covadonga and Julio at Clínica El Viso. Without a doubt, the best dog daycare in Madrid. 100% recommended.
Excellent service for dogs and their owners, and the vet is a true professional. Highly recommended, but be sure to book in advance.
It's wonderful to have such a trustworthy place where our dog stays (and comes back) so happily. We're absolutely delighted with Covi and how she takes care of Eco. 100% recommended.

Super attentive and friendly! The dog didn't want to leave :)
100% recommended

The staff at Covis daycare treat the dogs wonderfully and are very polite, but the owner of the boarding facility, an older lady who would be expected to be well-mannered and know how to treat customers given her extensive experience in the sector, is a very rude woman who, when any disagreement is expressed to her, instead of giving a response, resorts to insulting and disrespecting the customer, which is why I completely advise against using their boarding service.
Covis has been our groomer since Robin was a puppy, and we couldn't be happier. They always make her look gorgeous!
Excellent service both at the groomer's and the daycare; the staff are very friendly and attentive to the little ones 🐶 …

I took my dog ​​for a bath and haircut! And honestly, I was speechless at how gorgeous they made him look. You can definitely tell they love what they do. They explain everything clearly, and you can see they enjoy working with animals, which is the most important thing. 100% recommended. It's my new go-to groomer for my furry friend!
We couldn't be happier that our dog is staying at Covis for the holidays. The facilities are safe and clean, and they send us photos and videos daily. Thank you, Covis team!
Choco is very happy at daycare and loves it when I take him!
Wonderful girls, professional work, very affectionate with my pet, and their patience and charisma are evident.

I left my Sulio 🐶 at Covis's hotel and everything was great. They always take excellent care of him, take him for walks with other dogs, and you could tell he was happy 🐾💛. I bought a 10-day pass and I'm already planning to renew it. Highly recommended! 🐕✨ …
It's Kinga's hair salon and she always leaves happy; the girls are super attentive and professional.

A wonderful experience for my pet!

I've been taking my dog ​​there for over a year now, and I couldn't be happier with the service. From the very first moment, the treatment was exceptional! The communication was clear, and they were available, flexible, empathetic, and professional—all impeccable.

They also provided helpful advice on his care, demonstrating genuine interest in his well-being.

Without a doubt, I recommend them and will continue to take my pet there.
Thanks Laura!! :)

A trustworthy dog ​​daycare in Madrid

The team is very professional, attentive, and loving with the animals. It's clear they love what they do and are very focused on each dog's well-being.

The facilities are clean, well-maintained, and everything is perfect! Thank you so much!!! :)

At Covis, they treat Pauline very well and are adapting her environment to meet her needs. The caregivers are very kind. The kennel has windows overlooking the street, so it gets plenty of natural light, allowing the dogs to be entertained and relaxed watching people go by. Highly recommended!

I am extremely happy with the service and the staff at this place. Everyone is professional, friendly, and truly cares about the animals. My dog absolutely loves going to daycare—he gets excited every time we arrive, which says a lot! It’s clear that he feels comfortable, safe, and well taken care of.

The grooming services are also outstanding. The groomer is attentive to detail and always makes sure my dog looks and feels great after each visit.

Having Covis, since it opened, has been an indescribable source of peace of mind. For me, Keiki Jesús is the most important thing, and I entrust him to very, very few people; the Covis team is at the top of my list. It's key that Keiki socializes—maybe a little too much 😅—enjoys himself, and is well cared for. I started by leaving him with them for hours, then half-days, days, and even for up to 10 days at a time, but always with the confidence that he's home and well looked after. Those butterflies in my stomach when leaving him in someone else's care are a thing of the past. Thank you, Covis team! Keiki always comes back happy and tired—the best combination. I also love that whenever we pass by Covis, he always wants to go inside… even on Sundays!
